audit.scope: Spot checks of the OpenStreetMap fast-track overlay. Review commercial passenger operation before promoting a corridor into the starting network.
audit.candidate_filter: Open railway=rail or railway=maglev ways with highspeed=yes or a qualifying 200 km/h or 125 mph speed tag, excluding sidings, yards, spurs, crossovers and explicitly inactive or construction-tagged ways.

exclusions.basis: The Gautrain Management Agency identifies the 160 km/h service.

exclusions.tag_evidence: highspeed=yes on the AERA1 SkyTrain alignment
exclusions.basis: The project profile gives a maximum design speed of 160 km/h.

exclusions.tag_evidence: maxspeed=200 on the mixed-use Etihad Rail main line
exclusions.basis: Etihad Rail identifies the Abu Dhabi–Dubai high-speed project as a separate network. The extracted ways are on the national mixed-use line.

exclusions.description: Ain Sokhna section of Egypt's Green Line
exclusions.tag_evidence: railway=rail and highspeed=yes on a project section

exclusions.description: Two conventional approach fragments at Nyingchi
exclusions.tag_evidence: The extract retained two ways with maxspeed=200. OpenStreetMap corrected both to 160 km/h on 2026-11-03.

presets.orientation: Use the game document viewport: portrait when height > width; otherwise landscape. Do not infer orientation from the map rectangle or a width breakpoint.

portrait_timezone_defaults.offset_basis: Device-local standard UTC offset in minutes east of UTC, approximated by the smaller January/July offset in the current year; daylight saving does not move the boundary.
